profile.headline: Senior Engineering Manager | Software Design, AI, Machine Learning, Computer Vision
profile.summary: I’m a seasoned technology leader with deep expertise in machine learning, data engineering, and software product development. Throughout my career at Google and more recently at startups, I’ve built and managed high-performing teams that deliver scalable AI-driven solutions. Even while taking on management or cross-functional leadership roles I enjoy rolling up my sleeves working with code and data.  I thrive in a fast paced, collaborative environment. Let’s connect and explore how we can collaborate on innovative opportunities in this rapidly evolving field.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Software Engineering Manager (TLM) of Edge AI / Computer Vision Software team
 * Cross-functional DRI for development of real-time, multi-camera vehicle tracking system
 * Vehicle detection and tracking: deep neural net models (SSD, YOLO)
 * Multi-camera, sensor, & lens  hardware system design
 * C++, Python, Pytorch, MQTT, GStreamer, Nvidia Deepstream

TLM - Data Engineering
 * Data Warehousing design and development
 * Hiring new team members
positions.insights: Skills: Cross-functional Team Leadership · C++ · Software Infrastructure · Software Management · OpenCV · Cameras · Image Processing · Engineering Management · Python (Programming Language) · PyTorch · Data Engineering · Computer Vision
